dct_title_s: Philippines Flood Luzon: Flood Proxy Maps, Aug 2026
dct_description_sm: # Philippines Flood Luzon: Flood Proxy Maps, Aug 2026 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these flood proxy maps for Philippines Flood Luzon (Aug 2026) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Luzon, Philippines, Floods , 02 September 2026, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Luzon, Philippines, Floods , 14 August 2026, v0.9** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2026)
